unity.mapping: unity_local = (-bx, bz, -by) * import_scale; import the chunk FBX with the same ModelImporter settings as the intact module (globalScale, useFileScale, materials remapped by name); the chunk root placed on the intact module at identity overlays it
unity.units_note: values without suffix are Blender module space (m, Z up, before import scale); *_unity values are in the Unity model space of the module

frame.anchor_note: anchors test the core bounds (the masonry body without trim that overhangs it: corner bricks, a threshold below the floor), which is where the floor and the neighbour modules meet it

validation.intact_volume_note: closed non-glass parts after the embedded wood is taken out of the masonry (the union of masonry and wood); raw sum of parts before that: 0.955002
